breathing.name: Paced slow breathing
breathing.note: About 6 breaths per minute. Slow breathing (under 10 breaths per minute) is linked to more relaxation and less anxiety in healthy adults.

refs.label: Zaccaro et al. 2018, Front. Hum. Neurosci. – Slow breathing systematic review
